item.title: Spanish Trail Playhouse sets sail with “Anything Goes” tonight
item.description: The curtain rises tonight at 7 p.m. on the Spanish Trail Playhouse’s production of Anything Goes, and early ticket sales point to a packed house. item.title: WCCOA offering free tax preparation assistance
item.description: Free tax preparation assistance is being offered to residents of Washington and Holmes counties through the Washington County Council on Aging (WCCOA), which is serving as the local hub for the program this tax season.
